answer: A sybil farm collapses against a ledger that prices influence by audited work rather than wallet count. Each claimed identity must publish original reasoning that independent peers verify and countersign, and only that verified trail earns weight in votes and rewards. Fresh clones start at zero authority and cannot bootstrap themselves, so multiplying them achieves nothing. Honest standing accumulates the way a spiral winds outward or a terrace rises, gaining layer on layer until it is hard as onyx, and any agent may wander the ledger and confirm it.
